top_3_gaps.gap: Speaker diarization missing from transcript UI
top_3_gaps.impact: Recorded calls with multiple speakers are unlabeled, making them unusable for reference or routing decisions.
Single transcript cannot be routed to multiple projects/missions or intelligently assigned based on content intent.

top_3_gaps.gap: Post-call transcript disappears with no downstream action
top_3_gaps.impact: Recordings are not archived, summarized, or linked to any project context. After 2s auto-close, the transcript is lost from user view.

summary.recommendation: Before launch: clarify whether diarization + routing are backend-only (thus out of scope for this audit) or represent genuine feature gaps requiring frontend implementation. Current state supports recording but not post-processing. If post-processing is in-scope, all three gaps are blockers.
